import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][][][] dp;
    static int capacity, fats, slims;
    static long[][] ncr;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long pathCount(int fatsLeft, int slimsLeft, int ridesLeft, boolean boatPos) {
        if (fatsLeft == 0 && slimsLeft == 0 && ridesLeft == 0)
            return 1;
        if (ridesLeft == 0)
            return 0;
        if (dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatPos ? 0 : 1] != -1)
            return dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatPos ? 0 : 1];

        long totalWays = 0;
        if (boatPos) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= fatsLeft; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= slimsLeft; j++) {
                    if (i + j > 0 && i * 2 + j <= capacity)
                        totalWays += (ncr[fatsLeft][i] * ncr[slimsLeft][j] % MOD * pathCount(fatsLeft - i, slimsLeft - j, ridesLeft - 1, false)) % MOD;
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i <= fats - fatsLeft; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= slims - slimsLeft; j++) {
                    if (i + j > 0 && i * 2 + j <= capacity)
                        totalWays += (ncr[fats - fatsLeft][i] * ncr[slims - slimsLeft][j] % MOD * pathCount(fatsLeft + i, slimsLeft + j, ridesLeft - 1, true)) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatPos ? 0 : 1] = totalWays;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        capacity = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) / 50;
        fats = 0;
        slims = 0;
        String[] tokens = br.readLine().split(" ");
        for (String t : tokens) {
            int val = Integer.parseInt(t);
            if (val == 100)
                fats++;
            else
                slims++;
        }
        dp = new long[fats + 1][slims + 1][201][2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= fats; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= slims; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k <= 200; k++)
                    dp[i][j][k][0] = dp[i][j][k][1] = -1;
        ncr = new long[51][51];
        ncr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i - 1][j] + (j > 0 ? ncr[i - 1][j - 1] : 0)) % MOD;
            }
        }
        for (int rides = 1; rides <= 200; rides++) {
            long ways = pathCount(fats, slims, rides, true);
            if (ways != 0) {
                System.out.println(rides);
                System.out.println(ways);

        System.out.println(-1);
